name: wave1-S09-fluff-tufts-r2
refs: Our signed young S09, Belatz (project-owned): a small round BIRD with a short beak, round head, small feather crest and a short fan of tail feathers, cobalt plumage. It has no fur and no mammal ears.
Our signed Fluff plate (between): the framing, brush and light of the TOP ROW; its down is the middle look.
Our signed Tufts plate (body only): the framing, brush and light of the BOTTOM ROW.
prompt: Paint SIX panels in a 3 by 2 grid, equal size, small gaps, all of the same cobalt bird. TOP ROW: the same close-up of the bird's back and folded wing as the Fluff reference, the same pose; only the soft down over the feathers changes, and the three must be unmistakably different: left 'short, straight' (almost no down: smooth sleek feathers lying flat and tight, crisp feather edges), middle 'between' (as the reference: a light soft down), right 'long, swept' (long wispy down streaming back over the whole back in soft drifts, hiding the feather edges). BOTTOM ROW: the whole small round bird seen from behind at three-quarters, beak and crest just visible, its short fan of tail feathers behind; only where fluffy feather tufts grow changes: left 'body only' (fluffy tufts on the round body, a plain smooth tail fan, a plain smooth head), middle 'tail' (body tufts and a fluffy tufted tail fan), right 'tail and ears' (body tufts, a tufted tail fan and two small upright feather tufts on the head like an owl's ear tufts). It is a bird in every panel: no fur, no mammal ears, no bushy mammal tail. Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) between and around the panels and behind the bird, no borders, no text, no numbers. Same brush and soft painterly light from the top left as the references. No props, no ground, no shadow, no glow.

name: wave1-S04-fluff-r2
refs: Our signed young S04, Hiljan (project-owned): the creature and its tan and cream coat, exactly.
Our first sheet: keep its framing, brush and light; its middle panel is the 'between' look.
prompt: Paint THREE panels side by side, equal size, small gaps: the same close-up of the creature's shoulder and back in its tan coat, the cream underside just showing, as in the first sheet. Only the fur changes, and the three must be unmistakably different: left 'short, straight' (very short, sleek, close-lying fur, almost smooth, the body's shape crisp under it), middle 'between' (a soft medium coat, as the first sheet's middle panel), right 'long, swept' (long soft fur swept back in flowing locks that hide the shoulder line). Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) between and around the panels, no borders, no text, no numbers. Same brush and soft painterly light from the top left. No props, no ground, no shadow, no glow.
